Build FNaF World Ultra with local co-op and native online play for up to four players.

Download the patcher for your system:

- [Windows — FWUM-Patcher-Windows.exe](https://github.com/YesterMester/FNAF-World-Ultra-Multiplayer-/releases/latest/download/FWUM-Patcher-Windows.exe)
- [Steam Deck / Linux — FWUM-Patcher-Linux-SteamDeck](https://github.com/YesterMester/FNAF-World-Ultra-Multiplayer-/releases/latest/download/FWUM-Patcher-Linux-SteamDeck)

Run the patcher, choose where to build the game, then open the built game. On Steam Deck, mark the patcher executable first; use `Play Multiplayer.sh` to launch the game in Desktop Mode.

Press **F10 → Host game → Start co-op**. Friends select your lobby and join. Leave Code empty for an open lobby or enter exactly four digits. Everyone should build with the same patcher release.

Version 1.1.0 includes the battle turn, confirm-input and character/attack graphics fixes. The existing save in your output game folder is preserved when rebuilding there. The public lobby service is included and has free-plan daily capacity limits.

The patcher downloads the tested FNaF World Ultra 3.0.9 (in-game title 3.1.0) and Local Multiplayer 0.0.4, or uses your existing copies. Game files are built on each player's computer.

[Full instructions](https://github.com/YesterMester/FNAF-World-Ultra-Multiplayer-#getting-it) · [Changelog](https://github.com/YesterMester/FNAF-World-Ultra-Multiplayer-/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
